photos.file: Northern Leopard Frogs (Lithobates pipiens) - Waterloo, Ontario 04.jpg
photos.desc: Northern Leopard Frogs ( Lithobates pipiens ) in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada.

Northern leopard frogs are an important food source for many marsh birds here on the refuge. The frogs hibernate through the winter in the bottom of the Bear River or other source of oxygenated water.
A Northern Leopard Frog found in the Laurel Creek Conservation Area.
